TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a SECP-incorporated Pakistani company established in 2012, with active tax registrations and delivery presence in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi [CO-PROFILE]. We hold ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certifications and operate with CMMI Level 3 processes and PMP-certified project managers, providing a governance foundation aligned to the Ministry’s security and service-management expectations for a centralized 24x7 SOC and MDR program [CO-PROFILE]. Our team of 250 staff and in-country support desk model (with defined response SLAs on O&M engagements) enables sustained, multi-year service delivery [CO-PROFILE].

Across the last several years, we have executed multiple cybersecurity deployments with significant scale and duration, including projects valued at PKR 143M (completed 2025) and PKR 89M (33 months, completed 2019), and ISO 27001-certified cybersecurity delivery (e.g., PKR 111M, completed 2021; PKR 15M, 34 months, completed 2023) [CAP-013][CAP-037][CAP-025][CAP-001]. We also bring federal delivery experience through a major cloud infrastructure deployment completed in 2025 [CAP-012].

We will propose a Ministry-aligned SOC operating model (L1/L2/L3), SIEM/SOAR implementation, threat intelligence, threat hunting, incident response runbooks, vulnerability assessment reporting, and structured knowledge transfer over the three-year term.

Two mandatory eligibility items require transparent mitigation: (1) our evidenced average annual turnover is PKR 900M over the last three audited years, below the PKR 1,200M requirement [CO-PROFILE]; (2) our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC coverage across all tiers. We will address these via consortium/partnering with an eligible firm and by hiring/contracting certified SOC leads prior to mobilisation.

We can furnish bid security via scheduled-bank guarantees within our existing facility limits [CO-PROFILE].
